_comment: v21 campaign grid — MTF Sniper Logic (4H trend gate) + asymmetric barriers. First campaign with: (a) ATR stoploss bug fixed, (b) 4H MTF veto (no longs in 4H downtrend, no shorts in 4H uptrend), (c) RS-based dynamic thresholds from v21. 18 combos × 2 windows = 36 runs.

_grid_rationale.k_tp: 1.5×ATR → 1.5:1 R:R (theoretical PF=2.45 at 62% WR). 2.0×ATR → 2:1 R:R (PF=3.26, structural optimum). 2.5×ATR → 2.5:1 R:R (PF=4.07, but TP harder to reach within 6h).
_grid_rationale.k_sl: 0.8×ATR → tightest stop (more hits, but losses are smaller). 1.0×ATR → baseline. Both are tighter than v18 k_sl=2.0 which caused funding fee bleed.
_grid_rationale.ml_threshold: 0.60 = R8 winner. 0.65 = higher precision, fewer trades. 0.70 = sniper mode — max confidence only.
_grid_rationale.label_period_candles: Fixed at 6 (1h candles = 6h lookahead). R8 winner. K_SL=0.8-1.0×ATR resolves more labels within 6h.
_grid_rationale.mtf_filter: 4H EMA50 trend gate added in v22. No longs when pair close < pair 4H EMA50. No shorts when pair close > pair 4H EMA50. Expects fewer total trades but higher win rate on those taken.

_v18_v20_root_causes.v18: Symmetric barriers k_tp=k_sl. Fee drag (~$196/yr at 1700 trades/yr) exactly cancelled gross edge. PF 0.83-0.996 across all 24 runs.
_v18_v20_root_causes.v19_v20: ATR stoploss bug (wrong guard direction < 0 instead of > 0) meant hard -8% config stoploss fired for every loss since v17. ATR protection never worked. Fixed in commit 21796ea.
_v18_v20_root_causes.current: v21 added RS-based dynamic thresholds + removed hard regime blocks. WR 40.4% live — suspected cause: shorts taken against 4H uptrend. MTF filter is the fix.
